title: confiture migrate generate --format json
description: A new migration: from the Python template, or, with --generator, the `.up.sql` an external generator writes (`generator` is then present). `status` is `success`, or `dry_run` under --dry-run, when nothing is written. --verbose narrates the directory scan on stderr. An invalid name, a file that exists without --force, a --generator without --from/--to or not configured (CONFIG_001), or a generator that fails (GEN_001) writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

version.description: The new migration's version, a YYYYMMDDHHmmSS timestamp.

filepath.description: Absolute path of the migration file written (or that would be).

verify_file.description: The `.verify.sql` sidecar beside it; null under --no-verify-sidecar.

snapshot.description: The schema-history snapshot written, or null (--no-snapshot, or a snapshot that failed: non-fatal).

snapshot_mode.description: How the snapshot was taken; null when there is none.

warnings.description: Duplicate versions in the directory, or the name already used by another version; empty if none.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.

oneOf.description: --dry-run: the template that would be written.
